title: László Vetési Kökényesdi (as Cassimirus Miloftzki) to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 9 January 1706 (Ráday Archives C64-4d2-10, 92-95; DECODE R473)

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment over the cipher groups.

transcription.notes: DECODE spaces every digit, so --measure cannot split groups; align.py parses 373 groups in glossed runs.

system.summary: Hungarian syllabic numerical nomenclator with homophones and dotted multi-digit groups for names and dates.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear decipherment on the letter; cited to Ráday Pál iratai I (1955) p. 494 n. 1

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; supplied the DECODE session cookie earlier.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R473 record page, transcription DOC_R473_D3610 and images 3612-3614 with the project cookie (fetch_img.py).
Read DECODE's transcription: Hungarian clear text with numerical cipher runs, each run under a contemporary interlinear gloss.
Checked images 3612 and 3614: the interlinear decipherment is in a contemporary hand over nearly every group; endorsement '1706 I. 9' and closing 'Kilencedik Januarii' date the letter 9 Jan 1706.
Pencil note 'H.o. R.I. 102 a 1 jegyzet. 494. p.' identified as Raday Pal iratai I (1955) item 102 n. 1 p. 494; Szaktars copy paywalled (403), not checked.
Hard-EM alignment of cipher runs with DECODE's transcription of the glosses (align.py) to rebuild the key: too noisy, 154/373 groups in mismatched runs; key not rebuilt.

outcome.method_basis: A contemporary interlinear decipherment stands over almost every cipher group of R473, cited to Ráday Pál iratai I (1955) p. 494 n. 1; an attempt to rebuild the key from it failed on DECODE's noisy transcription.
outcome.fraction_read_source: not counted; the contemporary interlinear covers nearly every cipher group (a few, incl. the place in the date line, unglossed)
outcome.notes: Read at the time (interlinear decipherment); date corrected to 9 Jan 1706 and addressee to Rákóczi; nothing new read.
